title.zh-TW: 註冊新會員，可得高達 NT$264 的航班、飯店預訂優惠
title.en: Sign up as a new member: up to NT$264 in flight and hotel booking offers

text.zh-TW: 透過連結註冊的新會員可得；邀請頁未說明適用範圍、最低消費與期限。取自平台分享文案與官方頁面；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: New members via the link; the invite page states no scope, minimum spend or deadline. From the share text and official pages; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請頁（Trip.com 台灣站）；推薦碼已包含在連結中。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite page (Trip.com Taiwan site); the referral code is already in the link.

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載 Trip.com App，並以新會員身分註冊。
steps.en: Follow the page to download the Trip.com app and register as a new member.

steps.zh-TW: 若 App 註冊時要求輸入推薦碼，選擇「我有註冊推薦碼」並輸入 OMJRPP。
steps.en: If the app asks for a referral code at sign-up, choose 我有註冊推薦碼 (I have a sign-up referral code) and enter OMJRPP.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊後到帳號內的「優惠代碼」查看優惠；金額、範圍與期限以官方公告為準。
steps.en: After registering, look under 優惠代碼 (promo codes) in your account; amount, scope and deadline follow the official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請連結註冊 Trip.com 會員，依分享文案可得高達 NT$264 的航班、飯店預訂優惠。
intro.en: Sign up for Trip.com via this link; per the share text, get up to NT$264 in flight and hotel booking offers.

description.zh-TW:
Trip.com 是線上旅遊預訂平台，提供航班、飯店等預訂，台灣站是 tw.trip.com。這是邀請人專屬的邀請頁連結，推薦碼 OMJRPP 已包含在連結中。

依分享文案與邀請頁標題，透過連結註冊新會員可獲得高達 NT$264 的航班、飯店預訂優惠。邀請頁沒有說明適用範圍、最低消費與期限，實際內容以 Trip.com 官方公告為準。
description.en:
Trip.com is an online travel booking platform for flights, hotels and more, and its Taiwan site is tw.trip.com. This is the referrer’s personal invite page link, and referral code OMJRPP is already part of the link.

According to the share text and the invite page title, a new member who signs up through the link gets up to NT$264 in flight and hotel booking offers. The invite page states no scope, minimum spend or deadline, so actual terms follow Trip.com’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 推薦碼 OMJRPP 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫）。本站沒有註冊或登入測試推薦碼是否被接受，也沒有確認優惠實際入帳。邀請頁位於台灣站，金額為新台幣；其他地區是否適用未確認。Trip.com 的一般服務條款沒有推薦計畫的條文，連結規則只允許連結其首頁，也沒有說明第三方能否公開會員的推薦連結。
notes.en: Referral code OMJRPP is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization. Nobody registered or logged in to test whether the code is accepted or whether the offer is credited. The invite page is on the Taiwan site with amounts in NT$; whether it applies elsewhere was not checked. Trip.com’s general terms contain no referral-programme clause; their linking rules allow links to the homepage only, and they do not say whether third parties may publish members’ referral links.

q.zh-TW: Trip.com 的推薦碼 OMJRPP 要在哪裡輸入？
q.en: Where do I enter Trip.com referral code OMJRPP?

a.zh-TW: 推薦碼已包含在邀請連結中，直接透過本頁連結註冊即可。若在 App 註冊時需要輸入，依 Trip.com 官方邀請好友活動頁，選擇「我有註冊推薦碼」，並依原樣（含大小寫）輸入 OMJRPP。
a.en: The code is already part of the invite link, so just sign up through the link on this page. If the app asks for it at sign-up, Trip.com’s invite-a-friend page says to choose 我有註冊推薦碼 and enter OMJRPP exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: NT$264 的優惠適用於什麼？有期限嗎？
q.en: What does the NT$264 offer cover, and is there a deadline?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案寫的是航班、飯店預訂優惠；邀請頁只寫 NT$264 優惠代碼，沒有說明適用範圍、最低消費與期限。官方邀請好友活動頁寫的金額是 NT$300 以上，兩者不同，請以 Trip.com 官方公告為準。
a.en: The share text says flight and hotel booking offers; the invite page only says an NT$264 promo code, with no scope, minimum spend or deadline. The official invite-a-friend page shows NT$300 or more, which differs, so Trip.com’s official announcements prevail.
